newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-GIO says outlook reasonably positive.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-GIO says outlook reasonably positive.

text.p: Insurance group GIO Australia Holdings Ltd said on Monday the outlook for the current financial year to June 30, 1997 remained reasonably positive.
"The outlook for the current financial year remains reasonable positive," GIO Chairman John Lliffe said in his speech to the group's annual meeting.
GIO said the outlook in most investment markets was also positive for the rest of 1996/97, but that it expected returns in some sectors to be more subdued than over the past year.
GIO Managing Director Bill Jocelyn told Reuters in early September after the group's 1995/96 result that GIO was targetting double digit growth for its non investment business units for 1996/97.
GIO's net earnings before transfers to the disaster reserve fell to A$150.2 million from A$156.6 million.

It said then it saw an improved performance from its general insurance and managed investment activities and a positive outlook for the investment and reinsurance markets in the year to June 30, 1997.
